page: Microsoft Azure M176bds_v3 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the MBDSMediumMemoryv3 family. It features 176 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8473C processors running at a clock speed of 4.0 GHz. This configuration consists of 88 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 1536.0 GB of RAM, providing approximately 8.73 GB of memory per core. Local storage is provided via a 410 GB disk, and the instance is premium storage capable.

Benchmark results place this server in the top tier for multi-core CPU performance, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 141482.89 and a PassMark CPU score of 119417.63. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, reaching 432.14 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 186.33 GB/sec for large-block writes, both ranking in the top 10% of tested systems. The processor's support for Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) contributes to strong performance in specialized workloads, including a PassMark CPU extended instructions score of 173928.68 and strong LLM inference speeds for medium and large models.

Given its high resource density, including a massive memory footprint paired with 176 dedicated vCPUs, the M176bds_v3 offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring substantial memory-to-CPU ratios without needing dedicated GPU hardware. The server is highly optimized for large-scale database operations, as evidenced by its top-tier PassMark database score and 170.86 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks. It is also well-suited for memory-intensive enterprise applications, heavy multi-threaded compilation, and large-scale data processing.
